FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 264
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Jack W. Williams
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/10/2026
Senate Bill 264 as introduced could increase the obligations of certain municipalities that opt to
extend its corporate limits by an undetermined amount dependent upon (1) the amount and cost
of elections held relating to the proposed annexation and (2) costs associated with the control,
management, supervision, maintenance, repair, and improvements of annexed public streets,
roads, or bridges.
